label: 5. Maestro, do you remember Tetra Net?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Maestro, do you remember Tetra Net?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I mentioned it before.
The one where the troupe suggested you host a channel?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Yes, that's it.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Well, it took some time, but I finally made it.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Now, you can watch my performances any time you want.
That's awesome!

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Do you know how to subscribe to the channels?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I recently learned how to, so if you're not sure, I can teach you.
I've already subscribed.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Oh my, already? I'm touched.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I only just started, so how did you know?
It popped up on the trending section.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Trending section?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: What's that?
It's where popular videos are displayed.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Wow, I see.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I'm not entirely certain, but it's reassuring to see the channel taking off.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Creating this channel was a wise decision after all.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: So, thank you.
Hey, it seems like something's on your mind. What's up?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Well, it's pertaining to managing the official channel.
What's wrong?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: The troupe leader suggests taking a video for the premiere,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: but I don't know what kind of concept I should go with.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: It'd be nice if you can give me some ideas.
How about a Q&A session where you answer everything?
How about kicking off with a personal vlog?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: There might be some questions I'd rather not answer,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: since I like to keep some things private.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: A vlog? What's that?
It's a video where you share your everyday life.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I'm a bit apprehensive about showing myself outside my performances.
Honestly, so long as you're the focus, it'll be riveting no matter what.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I think I understand what you're getting at.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Thank you, Maestro.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I'll try to make a personal video for my fans.
I'll be sure to like it when you upload it.
